dict.string: Task Mentor uses the camera for proctored quizzes, Tupo for video meetings, and the Scanner tool to photograph pages (photos stay on this computer).
Tupo uses the microphone for meetings and voice messages, and the Noise meter tool measures how loud the room is (nothing is recorded).
Tupo meetings and live proctoring connect calls directly over your school network when they can, for clearer audio and video.
Tupo uses speech recognition to show live captions in meetings.
